name: proton-mail-mcp
description: Search and read Proton Mail, write drafts and tidy the mailbox through Proton Mail Bridge, with a preview you approve before anything changes.
long_description: This bundle is only the connector. It runs `proton-mail-mcp connect`, which passes Claude Desktop's requests to the proton-mail-mcp service on 127.0.0.1 and reads the service's bearer token from the system credential store each time it starts, so the token is never in Claude Desktop's settings. Run `proton-mail-mcp setup` on this computer first: it installs Proton Mail Bridge, stores the credentials and starts the service. Unofficial: not affiliated with or endorsed by Proton AG.
